> **Monorepo Path Architecture (`NSE_ROOT`)**: This repository uses a mirrored `code/` and `data/` directory structure rooted at the **`NSE_ROOT`** environment variable. All source code resides under `$NSE_ROOT/code/<ENGINE>` and all runtime artifacts (logs, SQLite/DuckDB databases, Parquet datasets, trained ML models, and generated reports) reside in the mirrored `$NSE_ROOT/data/<ENGINE>` directory.

# CLI reference

`nsealgo` has 28 commands. Run `nsealgo <command> --help` for the same text.

| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [`accounts`](#accounts) | Multi-broker allocation table: which account trades which stock. |
| [`anatomy`](#anatomy) | Bar anatomy of one stock: gap / excursions / drift, empirical tail rates vs the Edgeworth expansion. |
| [`backtest`](#backtest) | Backtest on stored history through the live engine, spread across all cores (research mode). |
| [`bench`](#bench) | Measure the multi-core speedup on this machine (synthetic market; checks results are identical). |
| [`book-study`](#book-study) | Does deeper order-book data predict short-term moves better than the top level? On your recording. |
| [`brokers`](#brokers) | List broker adapters, their maturity and install commands. |
| [`demo`](#demo) | Offline end-to-end demo on a SYNTHETIC market: daily + minute backtests and a quote-level replay. |
| [`desk`](#desk) | Trading desk: dashboard, tier-1 50-level depth, market watch. Read-only except the kill switch. |
| [`doctor`](#doctor) | Check Python, installed broker SDKs, stdlib-shadowing packages, config and data. |
| [`feed-check`](#feed-check) | Stream the same instruments from several brokers and compare speed, completeness and stability. |
| [`feeds`](#feeds) | Which brokers give free live market data, their stream caps and how they log in. |
| [`fetch-history`](#fetch-history) | Download daily (and 1-minute) history into data/history.db. |
| [`forwardtest`](#forwardtest) | Paper-trade on live market data with the conservative simulated exchange. |
| [`fractal`](#fractal) | Trend vs mean-reversion diagnostics from stored 1-minute bars (variance ratios, DFA Hurst, MF-DFA). |
| [`gpu`](#gpu) | GPU check: the PyTorch device, and per kernel NumPy-vs-GPU agreement, timing and the choice made. |
| [`hardware`](#hardware) | Detected cores/threads/RAM, the worker counts nsealgo will use, BLAS libraries and start method. |
| [`kill`](#kill) | Emergency stop. all: no new entries, intraday flattened. intraday: no new intraday entries, intraday |
| [`leadlag`](#leadlag) | Measure minute-level lead-lag (transfer entropy + lagged correlation) from stored 1-minute bars. |
| [`live`](#live) | Trade real money. Requires the explicit risk flag. |
| [`login`](#login) | Interactive daily login; caches today's session token (mode 0600) and the instrument master. |
| [`netcheck`](#netcheck) | Order path: egress IP through the configured proxy, and new-connection vs kept-alive latency. |
| [`replay`](#replay) | Replay a recorded session (recordings/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl.gz) through the full stack. |
| [`report`](#report) | Rebuild the HTML/Markdown report for a run directory (containing state.db). |
| [`resume`](#resume) | Remove the kill switch(es) (restart the process to clear an in-memory halt). |
| [`smoke-test`](#smoke-test) | End-to-end check of a broker adapter against your real account. |
| [`tbt-check`](#tbt-check) | What a TBT recording holds: messages, how often ltq / vtt_diff come, latency percentiles. |
| [`tbt-record`](#tbt-record) | Record Fyers TBT 50-level depth for up to 15 stocks to parquet (paths.tbt_dir), without running any strategy. |
| [`walkforward`](#walkforward) | Parameter-perturbation robustness test (+/-20%), all variants in parallel. |

## accounts

Multi-broker allocation table: which account trades which stock.

```
nsealgo accounts [options]
```

| Argument / option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--pin` |  | SYMBOL=ACCOUNT: trade this stock at this account |
| `--unpin` |  | SYMBOL: let the balancer place it again |
| `--rebalance` |  | Re-spread idle, unpinned stocks by capacity |

## anatomy

Bar anatomy of one stock: gap / excursions / drift, empirical tail rates vs the Edgeworth expansion.

```
nsealgo anatomy <symbol> [options]
```

| Argument / option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `symbol` |  |  |
| `--days` | `250` | Sessions of daily history to use |
| `--move` | `0.01` | Event size, e.g. 0.01 = 1% |

## backtest

Backtest on stored history through the live engine, spread across all cores (research mode).

```
nsealgo backtest <start> <end> [options]
```

| Argument / option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `start` |  |  |
| `end` |  |  |
| `--granularity` | `daily` | daily \| minute |
| `--strategies` |  | Comma list (default: enabled in config) |
| `--master-from` |  | Broker name or CSV with an instrument master (futures, ticks) |
| `--workers` | `auto` | Worker processes: auto = one per physical core, or a number |
| `--split` |  | auto \| strategy (one job per strategy) \| none |
| `--faithful` |  | Single engine exactly like live: compounding, Kelly learning, shared caps, drawdown breaker (one core) |

## bench

Measure the multi-core speedup on this machine (synthetic market; checks results are identical).

```
nsealgo bench [options]
```

| Argument / option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--dir` | `bench_run` |  |
| `--workers` | `auto` |  |
| `--swing-days` | `1000` |  |
| `--intraday-days` | `10` |  |

## book-study

Does deeper order-book data predict short-term moves better than the top level? On your recording.

```
nsealgo book-study <recordings> [options]
```

| Argument / option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `recordings` |  | Recorded sessions with depth (recordings/*.jsonl.gz); several days are studied together in memory |
| `--horizons` | `5,30,60` | Seconds ahead, comma-separated |
| `--levels` | `1,5,10,20` | Depth levels to compare, comma-separated |

## kill

Emergency stop. all: no new entries, intraday flattened. intraday: no new intraday entries, intraday
flattened. swing: no new swing entries (open swing positions keep their stops).

```
nsealgo kill [options]
```

| Argument / option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--mode` | `live` |  |
| `--book` | `all` | all \| intraday \| swing |

## tbt-record

Record Fyers TBT 50-level depth for up to 15 stocks to parquet (paths.tbt_dir), without running any strategy.
Uses today's Fyers token from NSEUIENGINE's 08:00 task (or `nsealgo login fyers`).

```
nsealgo tbt-record [options]
```

| Argument / option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--symbols` |  | Comma list of NSE stocks, at most 15, e.g. SBIN,RELIANCE,INFY |
| `--until` | `15:31` | Stop at this IST time |
| `--minutes` |  | Or stop after this many minutes |
